newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Geopetrol, Conoco tipped for prime Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Geopetrol, Conoco tipped for prime Vietnam.

text.p: Oil industry sources said on Wednesday France's Geopetrol and a consortium led by Conoco Inc were close to final agreement with state firm Petrovietnam over exploration rights to a prime offshore block.
They said the two companies were "working out the fineprint" with Petrovietnam officials for a licence to prospect in the 15-1 block, which lies off the country's south-east coast.
The sources said an announcement, which has been expected for more than a year, was likely soon.
Block 15-1 has been attracting attention since 1994 because of significant finds in adjacent areas.
The triangular block, about 150 km from Ho Chi Minh City, lies to the north of Vietnam's biggest producing field, Bach Ho (White Tiger).
Neither Petrovietnam, Conoco, nor Geopetrol were willing to comment on Wednesday.
Analysts said Vietnam may award a joint exploration licence, because of Geopetrol's low industry profile.
Conoco is a unit of U.S. firm DuPont Co. It leads a consortium grouping South Korea's Petroleum Development Corporation (Pedco) and Yukong Ltd.
